Anna Li: Quick heads-up — in prod around 15:03 we saw a bunch of 413s from the embeddings route when mixed-dim requests hit the preflight. /cc @Chao @Mike
Chao Wang: Hmm. Which preflight? the new dim-negotiation middleware? Any traces?
Anna Li: Yes the dim-negotiation one. Logs show: `embed_splitter: could not split request (mixed_dims)` then route fallback triggered which bounced between embed-route-A and embed-route-B. Metrics: spike in `route_rebinds_total` and `embed_413_rate` ~3x baseline.
Mike Carter: Can you paste the raw request header? Might be client sending `X-Embed-Dims: 64,512` and our preflight assumed homogeneous dims.
Anna Li: Here's sample (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
X-Embed-Dims: 512,64
Accept: application/json
Content-Length: 1.2MB
```
Sara Patel: That's expected from some hybrid clients. We previously said mixed dims should be split into multiple calls but runtime currently fast-fails if first split candidate exceeds bytes limit.
Chao Wang: Proposed short-term: console toggle to opt-in to automatic mixed-dim splitting -> runtime returns 202 with job id and async batching. Long-term: negotiation header `X-Embed-Shape: prefer-split|prefer-fail` so clients can express preference.
Julian (console): From console UX POV we can add a per-tenant `mixed_dim_behavior` setting (default `fail`) + a quick link to "suggest best split" which runs preflight analysis and shows estimated cost/latency. UX mock: /console/tenants/<id>/embed-settings -> radio buttons + sample preflight.
Mike Carter: Telemetry we need: 1) `embed_negotiation_decision{tenant,policy}` 2) `embed_split_attempts_total` 3) `embed_async_enqueue_latency_ms` 4) `embed_413_reason` label for bytes vs dims.
Anna Li: +1. Also capture `preflight_estimated_tokens` and returned `suggested_split_plan` (store as short hash) for diffs.
Sara Patel: Edge case: some tenants rely on single-call atomic semantics — async enqueue breaks that. Should be opt-in per api-key or tenant.
Chao Wang: Agreed. API change list: add header `X-Embed-Async: true|false`, add `?preflight=true` query for client-side preview. Console flag maps to `X-Embed-Async` for managed clients.
Mike Carter: Implementation notes: runtime change in splitter service and router policy. Need circuit to fallback to existing behavior if enqueue queue > 90th pct.
dev-bot: deploy scheduled to canary at 1716618200 by @Mike Carter :rocket:
Julian (console): I'll draft a console mock and a telemetry dashboard: widgets showing `embed_413_rate`, `embed_split_success_rate`, `avg_latency_by_dim` and a "suggested_split_coverage" heatmap.
Anna Li: Thanks — can we also add a small tooltip in console explaining tradeoffs: cost vs latency vs atomicity? Product wants wording.
Sara Patel: I'll write suggested copy and policy defaults.
Mike Carter: Plan: short-term feature flag rollout -> canary runtime + console opt-in + metric plumbing -> monitor 24h -> widen. Anyone object?
Chao Wang: No objections. Add migration note to API changelog and samples in SDKs.
Anna Li: Great. I'll open the RFC PR with mockups and metrics list.
Mike Carter: tagging this thread to the rollout tracker: #embed-shape-negotiation
Anna Li: :thumbsup:
